units.zh: 蕭子恪 弟子範 子顯 子雲
units.en: Xiao Zike; his younger brother Zifan; Xiao Zixian; Xiao Ziyun
units.literal: Xiao Zike; his younger brother Zifan; Zixian; Ziyun

units.zh: 蕭子恪，字景沖，蘭陵人，齊豫章文獻王嶷第二子也。
units.en: Xiao Zike, styled Jingchong, came from Lanling and was the second son of Yi, Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang under Qi.
units.literal: Xiao Zike, styled Jingchong, came from Lanling and was the second son of Yi, Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang under Qi.

units.zh: 永明中，以王子封南康縣侯。
units.en: During Yongming, as a prince's son he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Nankang county.
units.literal: During Yongming, as a prince's son he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Nankang county.

units.zh: 年十二，和從兄司徒竟陵王《高松賦》，衛軍王儉見而奇之。
units.en: At twelve, he wrote a matching piece to his elder cousin the Prince of Jingling, Minister over the Masses, on the "Rhapsody on Tall Pines"; Wang Jian, General of the Guard, saw it and marveled.
units.literal: At twelve, he wrote a matching piece to his elder cousin the Prince of Jingling, Minister over the Masses, on the "Rhapsody on Tall Pines"; Wang Jian, General of the Guard, saw it and marveled.

units.zh: 初爲寧朔將軍、淮陵太守，建武中，遷輔國將軍、吳郡太守。
units.en: He first served as General Who Pacifies the North and administrator of Huailing; during Jianwu he was transferred to General Who Supports the State and administrator of Wu Commandery.
units.literal: He first served as General Who Pacifies the North and administrator of Huailing; during Jianwu he was transferred to General Who Supports the State and administrator of Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 大司馬王敬則於會稽舉兵反，以奉子恪爲名，明帝悉召子恪兄弟親從七十餘人入西省，至夜當害之。
units.en: When Grand Marshal Wang Jingze raised troops in rebellion at Kuaiji, claiming he would uphold Zike, Emperor Ming summoned Zike, his brothers, and more than seventy close followers into the Western Office, intending to kill them that night.
units.literal: When Grand Marshal Wang Jingze raised troops in rebellion at Kuaiji, claiming he would uphold Zike, Emperor Ming summoned Zike, his brothers, and more than seventy close followers into the Western Office, intending to kill them that night.

units.zh: 會子恪棄郡奔歸，是日亦至，明帝乃止，以子恪爲太子中庶子。
units.en: As it happened, Zike abandoned his commandery and rushed back, arriving that same day; Emperor Ming then stopped and made Zike Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: As it happened, Zike abandoned his commandery and rushed back, arriving that same day; Emperor Ming then stopped and made Zike Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 東昏卽位，遷秘書監，領右軍將軍，俄爲侍中。
units.en: When Donghun took the throne, Zike was promoted to Palace Library Director, concurrently General of the Right Army, and soon became Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: When Donghun took the throne, Zike was promoted to Palace Library Director, concurrently General of the Right Army, and soon became Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 中興二年，遷輔國諮議參軍。
units.en: In Zhongxing 2, he was transferred to advisory army aide to the General Who Supports the State.
units.literal: In Zhongxing 2, he was transferred to advisory army aide to the General Who Supports the State.

units.zh: 天監元年，降爵爲子，除散騎常侍，領步兵校尉，以疾不拜，徙爲光祿大夫，俄爲司徒左長史。
units.en: In Tianjian 1, his title was reduced to viscount; he was appointed Regular Attendant, concurrently Infantry Colonel, but did not take office because of illness. He was shifted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and soon became left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: In Tianjian 1, his title was reduced to viscount; he was appointed Regular Attendant, concurrently Infantry Colonel, but did not take office because of illness. He was shifted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and soon became left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 子恪與弟子範等，嘗因事入謝，高祖在文德殿引見之，從容謂曰：「我欲與卿兄弟有言。
units.en: Zike and his younger brother Zifan and the others once came to court to offer thanks on official business. Emperor Wu received them in the Wende Hall and said at his ease, "I wish to speak with you brothers.
units.literal: Zike and his younger brother Zifan and others once entered to give thanks on an affair; the High Ancestor received them in the Wende Hall and said at ease, "I wish to have words with you brothers.

units.zh: 夫天下之寶，本是公器，非可力得。
units.en: The treasures of the realm are by nature the common property of all; they cannot be seized by force.
units.literal: Now, the treasures of All-under-Heaven are by nature public instruments; they cannot be obtained by force.

units.zh: 苟無期運，雖有項籍之力，終亦敗亡。
units.en: Without the proper season of fortune, even with the strength of Xiang Yu, one would in the end be defeated and destroyed.
units.literal: If one lacks the season of fortune, though one have the strength of Xiang Yu, in the end one will be defeated and perish.

units.zh: 所以班彪《王命論》云：『所求不過一金，然終轉死溝壑』。
units.en: Hence Ban Biao's Discourse on the Mandate of Kingship says, "What he sought was no more than a single piece of gold, yet in the end he died in ditches and gullies."
units.literal: Therefore Ban Biao's "Discourse on the Mandate of Kingship" says, "What he sought was no more than one piece of gold, yet in the end he turned to die in ditches and gullies."

units.zh: 卿不應不讀此書。
units.en: You ought to have read this book.
units.literal: You ought not to have failed to read this book.

units.zh: 宋孝武爲性猜忌，兄弟粗有令名者，無不因事鴆毒，所遺唯有景和。
units.en: Emperor Xiaowu of Song was by nature suspicious and jealous. Of his brothers who had any reputation at all, none escaped being poisoned on one pretext or another—only Jinghe was left alive.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowu of Song was by nature suspicious and jealous; of his brothers who roughly had a good name, none failed to be poisoned on some pretext—only Jinghe was left.

units.zh: 至於朝臣之中，或疑有天命而致害者，枉濫相繼，然而或疑有天命而不能害者，或不知有天命而不疑者，于時雖疑卿祖，而無如之何。
units.en: Among the court ministers as well, some whom he suspected of possessing the Mandate of Heaven were destroyed, and wrongful killings followed one after another. Yet some whom he suspected of possessing the Mandate of Heaven he could not destroy, and some who did not know they possessed the Mandate of Heaven he did not suspect. At that time he did suspect your grandfather, yet could do nothing about it.
units.literal: As for the court ministers, some whom he suspected of possessing the Mandate of Heaven he harmed, and wrongful killings followed one after another; yet some whom he suspected of possessing the Mandate of Heaven he could not harm, and some who did not know they possessed the Mandate of Heaven he did not suspect. At that time, though he suspected your grandfather, he could do nothing about it.

units.zh: 此是疑而不得。
units.en: This was a case of suspecting but being unable to act.
units.literal: This was a case of suspecting but not being able to obtain the result.

units.zh: 又有不疑者，如宋明帝本爲庸常被免，豈疑而得全？
units.en: There were also those he did not suspect, such as Emperor Ming of Song, who had originally been a mediocre man and was dismissed from office—how could suspicion have preserved him?
units.literal: There were also those he did not suspect, such as Emperor Ming of Song, who had originally been a mediocre commoner and was dismissed—how could suspicion have preserved him?

units.zh: 又復我于時已年二歲，彼豈知我應有今日？
units.en: Moreover, at that time I was already two years old—how could he have known that I was destined for what I have today?
units.literal: Moreover, at that time I was already two years old—how could he have known that I was destined for what I have today?

units.zh: 當知有天命者，非人所害，害亦不能得。
units.en: You should understand that one who possesses the Mandate of Heaven cannot be harmed by men; even if harm is attempted, it cannot succeed.
units.literal: You should know that one who possesses the Mandate of Heaven cannot be harmed by men; even if harm is attempted, it cannot be obtained.

units.zh: 我初平建康城，朝廷內外皆勸我云：『時代革異，物心須一，宜行處分。』
units.en: When I first pacified Jiankang, everyone inside and outside the court urged me, saying, "The age has changed; minds must be unified; you ought to take decisive measures."
units.literal: When I first pacified Jiankang, everyone inside and outside the court urged me, saying, "The age has changed; minds must be unified; you ought to take decisive measures."

units.zh: 我于時依此而行，誰謂不可！
units.en: At the time I acted accordingly—who would say it was wrong!
units.literal: At the time I acted accordingly—who would say it was not permissible!

units.zh: 我政言江左以來，代謝必相誅戮，此是傷於和氣，所以國祚例不靈長。
units.en: I maintain only that since the establishment of the regime south of the Yangtze, each change of dynasty has been accompanied by mutual slaughter. This wounds the harmony of spirit, and so imperial fortunes as a rule do not last long.
units.literal: I maintain only that since the establishment of the regime south of the Yangtze, each change of dynasty has necessarily involved mutual slaughter—this wounds the harmony of spirit, and so imperial fortunes as a rule do not last long.

units.zh: 所謂『殷鑒不遠，在夏後之世』。
units.en: As the saying goes, "The lesson of Yin is not far off; it is in the age of the Xia descendants."
units.literal: As the saying goes, "The lesson of Yin is not far off; it is in the age of the Xia descendants."

units.zh: 此是一義。
units.en: This is the first point.
units.literal: This is the first point.

units.zh: 二者，齊梁雖曰革代，義異往時。
units.en: Second, although Qi and Liang are called a change of dynasty, the principle differs from times past.
units.literal: Second, although Qi and Liang are called a change of dynasty, the principle differs from times past.

units.zh: 我與卿兄弟雖復絕服二世，宗屬未遠。
units.en: Though you brothers and I are separated by two generations of mourning dress, our kinship is not remote.
units.literal: Though you brothers and I are separated by two generations of mourning dress, our kinship is not remote.

units.zh: 卿勿言兄弟是親，人家兄弟自有周旋者，有不周旋者，況五服之屬邪？
units.en: Do not speak of brothers as being close by nature. Among ordinary families, brothers have those who get along and those who do not—how much more so for kin within five degrees of mourning?
units.literal: Do not speak of brothers as being close—among ordinary families brothers have those who associate and those who do not; how much more so for kin within five degrees of mourning?

units.zh: 齊業之初，亦是甘苦共嘗，腹心在我。
units.en: In the early years of the Qi state, we too shared bitterness and sweetness, and the innermost confidence was placed in me.
units.literal: In the early years of the Qi enterprise, we too shared bitterness and sweetness; you were trusted as my inner confidants.

units.zh: 卿兄弟年少，理當不悉。
units.en: You brothers are young and can scarcely know this fully.
units.literal: You brothers are young and can scarcely know this fully.

units.zh: 我與卿兄弟，便是情同一家，豈當都不念此，作行路事。
units.en: With you brothers I am as close as one family. How could I fail to bear this in mind and treat you as strangers on the road?
units.literal: With you brothers I am as close as one family—how could I fail to bear this in mind and treat you as strangers on the road?

units.zh: 此是二義。
units.en: This is the second point.
units.literal: This is the second point.

units.zh: 我有今日，非是本意所求。
units.en: What I have today was not what I originally sought.
units.literal: What I have today was not what I originally sought.

units.zh: 且建武屠滅卿門，致卿兄弟塗炭。
units.en: Moreover, the Jianwu reign annihilated your clan's households and brought you brothers to ruin.
units.literal: Moreover, the Jianwu reign annihilated your clan's households and brought you brothers to ruin.

units.zh: 我起義兵，非惟自雪門恥，亦是爲卿兄弟報仇。
units.en: When I raised the army of righteousness, it was not only to avenge my own house's shame but also to take revenge for you brothers.
units.literal: When I raised the army of righteousness, it was not only to avenge my own house's shame but also to take revenge for you brothers.

units.zh: 卿若能在建武、永元之世，撥亂反正，我雖起樊、鄧，豈得不釋戈推奉；
units.en: Had you been able in the Jianwu and Yongyuan reigns to restore order and right the wrongs, though I had risen at Fan and Deng, how could I have failed to lay down my weapons and yield the lead?
units.literal: Had you been able in the Jianwu and Yongyuan reigns to restore order and right the wrongs, though I had risen at Fan and Deng, how could I have failed to lay down my weapons and yield the lead?

units.zh: 其雖欲不已，亦是師出無名。
units.en: Even had I wished to continue, it would have been a campaign without righteous cause.
units.literal: Even had I wished to continue, it would have been a campaign without righteous cause.

units.zh: 我今爲卿報仇，且時代革異，望卿兄弟盡節報我耳。
units.en: Now I have avenged you, and the age has changed. I look to you brothers to exhaust your loyalty in serving me.
units.literal: Now I have avenged you, and the age has changed; I look to you brothers to exhaust your loyalty in serving me.

units.zh: 且我自藉喪亂，代明帝家天下耳，不取卿家天下。
units.en: I took advantage of the chaos to inherit Emperor Ming's realm—I did not seize your family's realm.
units.literal: Moreover, I took advantage of the chaos to inherit Emperor Ming's realm—I did not seize your family's realm.

units.zh: 昔劉子輿自稱成帝子，光武言『假使成帝更生，天下亦不復可得，況子輿乎』。
units.en: In former times Liu Ziyu styled himself a son of Emperor Cheng; Emperor Guangwu said, "Suppose even Emperor Cheng were reborn—the realm could no longer be obtained; how much less Liu Ziyu?"
units.literal: In former times Liu Ziyu styled himself a son of Emperor Cheng; Emperor Guangwu said, "Suppose even Emperor Cheng were reborn—the realm could no longer be obtained; how much less Liu Ziyu?"

units.zh: 梁初，人勸我相誅滅者，我答之猶如向孝武時事：彼若苟有天命，非我所能殺；
units.en: Early in the Liang, there were those who urged me to carry out mass slaughter. I answered as in the time of Emperor Xiaowu: if they truly possessed the Mandate of Heaven, I could not kill them;
units.literal: Early in the Liang, there were those who urged me to carry out mass slaughter; I answered as in the time of Emperor Xiaowu: if they truly possessed the Mandate of Heaven, I could not kill them;

units.zh: 若其無期運，何忽行此，政足示無度量。
units.en: if they lacked the season of fortune, why suddenly do this—it would only show a want of magnanimity.
units.literal: if they lacked the season of fortune, why suddenly do this—it would only show a want of magnanimity.

units.zh: 曹志親是魏武帝孫，陳思之子，事晉武能爲晉室忠臣，此卽卿事例。
units.en: Cao Zhi was a close relative of Emperor Wu of Wei and a son of Prince Si of Chen; serving Emperor Wu of Jin he could be a loyal minister to the Jin house—this is exactly your case.
units.literal: Cao Zhi was a close relative of Emperor Wu of Wei and a son of Prince Si of Chen; serving Emperor Wu of Jin he could be a loyal minister to the Jin house—this is exactly your case.

units.zh: 卿是宗室，情義異佗，方坦然相期，卿無復懷自外之意。
units.en: You are of the imperial clan; your bond differs from others. I openly expect much of you—do not harbor thoughts of standing apart.
units.literal: You are of the imperial clan; your bond differs from others. I openly expect much of you; do not harbor thoughts of standing apart.

units.zh: 小待，自當知我寸心。」
units.en: Wait a little—you will come to know my true heart."
units.literal: Wait a little—you will come to know my true heart."

units.zh: 又文獻王時，內齋直帳閹人趙叔祖，天監初，入爲臺齋帥，在壽光省，高祖呼叔祖曰：「我本識汝在北第，以汝舊人，故每驅使。
units.en: Again, in the time of the Literary and Cultivated Prince, Zhao Shuzu was a eunuch attendant in the inner quarters. At the beginning of Tianjian he entered service as Master of the Terrace Quarters in the Shouguang office. The Emperor called Shuzu and said, "I knew you long ago at the Northern Residence, and because you are an old acquaintance I have you run errands often.
units.literal: Again, in the time of the Literary and Cultivated Prince, Zhao Shuzu was a eunuch attendant in the inner quarters; at the beginning of Tianjian he entered service as Master of the Terrace Quarters, in the Shouguang office. The High Ancestor called Shuzu and said, "I knew you long ago at the Northern Residence, and because you are an old acquaintance I have you run errands often.

units.zh: 汝比見北第諸郎不？」
units.en: Have you lately seen the various gentlemen of the Northern Residence?"
units.literal: Have you lately seen the various gentlemen of the Northern Residence?"

units.zh: 叔祖奉答云：「比多在直，出外甚疏，假使暫出，亦不能得往。」
units.en: Shuzu replied, "Of late I have mostly been on duty and have gone out very rarely. Even when I went out briefly I could not get there."
units.literal: Shuzu replied, "Of late I have mostly been on duty and have gone out very rarely; even when I went out briefly I could not get there."

units.zh: 高祖曰：「若見北第諸郎，道我此意：我今日雖是革代，情同一家；
units.en: The Emperor said, "If you see the gentlemen of the Northern Residence, convey my meaning: though today we have changed the dynasty, our feeling is as of one family;
units.literal: The High Ancestor said, "If you see the gentlemen of the Northern Residence, convey my meaning: though today we have changed the dynasty, our feeling is as of one family;

units.zh: 但今磐石未立，所以未得用諸郎者，非惟在我未宜，亦是欲使諸郎得安耳。
units.en: only because the foundation stone is not yet set, I have not been able to employ you gentlemen—not only because it would be improper for me, but also because I wish to let you gentlemen dwell in peace.
units.literal: only because the foundation stone is not yet set, I have not been able to employ you gentlemen—not only because it would be improper for me, but also because I wish to let you gentlemen dwell in peace.

units.zh: 但閉門高枕，後自當見我心。」
units.en: Simply shut your gates and rest your heads on high pillows—you will later come to see my heart."
units.literal: Simply shut your gates and rest your heads on high pillows—you will later come to see my heart."

units.zh: 叔祖卽出外具宣敕語。
units.en: Shuzu went out at once and fully proclaimed the imperial words.
units.literal: Shuzu went out at once and fully proclaimed the imperial words.

units.zh: 子恪尋出爲永嘉太守。
units.en: Soon afterward Zike was sent out as Administrator of Yongjia.
units.literal: Soon afterward Zike was sent out as Administrator of Yongjia.

units.zh: 還除光祿卿，秘書監。
units.en: On his return he was appointed Chamberlain for Ceremonials (Guanglu qing) and Superintendent of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On his return he was appointed Chamberlain for Ceremonials (Guanglu qing) and Superintendent of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 出爲明威將軍、零陵太守。
units.en: He went out as General of Illustrious Might and Administrator of Lingling.
units.literal: He went out as General of Illustrious Might and Administrator of Lingling.

units.zh: 十七年，入爲散騎常侍、輔國將軍。
units.en: In the seventeenth year he entered the court as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Assists the State.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he entered the court as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Assists the State.

units.zh: 普通元年，遷宗正卿。
units.en: In the first year of Putong he was promoted to Director of the Imperial Clan.
units.literal: In the first year of Putong he was promoted to Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 三年，遷都官尚書。
units.en: In the third year he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Justice.
units.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Justice.

units.zh: 四年，轉吏部。
units.en: In the fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 六年，遷太子詹事。
units.en: In the sixth year he was promoted to Steward of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Steward of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 大通二年，出爲寧遠將軍、吳郡太守。
units.en: In the second year of Datong he went out as General of Pacifying the Distance and Administrator of Wu Commandery.
units.literal: In the second year of Datong he went out as General of Pacifying the Distance and Administrator of Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 三年，卒于郡舍，時年五十二。
units.en: In the third year he died in the administrative residence, aged fifty-two.
units.literal: In the third year he died in the administrative residence, aged fifty-two.

units.zh: 詔贈侍中、中書令。
units.en: An edict posthumously appointed him Palace Attendant and Secretary of the Palace.
units.literal: An edict posthumously appointed him Palace Attendant and Secretary of the Palace.

units.zh: 諡曰恭。
units.en: His posthumous title was Gong (Respectful).
units.literal: His posthumous title was Gong (Respectful).

units.zh: 子恪兄弟十六人，並仕梁。
units.en: Zike and his brothers, sixteen in all, served in Liang.
units.literal: Zike's sixteen brothers all served in Liang.

units.zh: 有文學者，子恪、子質、子顯、子雲、子暉五人。
units.en: Those with literary accomplishment were five: Zike, Zizhi, Zixian, Ziyun, and Zihui.
units.literal: Those with literary accomplishment were five: Zike, Zizhi, Zixian, Ziyun, and Zihui.

units.zh: 子恪嘗謂所親曰：「文史之事，諸弟備之矣，不煩吾復牽率，但退食自公，無過足矣。」
units.en: Zike once told those close to him, "Matters of letters and history—my younger brothers have them fully covered. I need not lead the way again. Only to withdraw after eating and attend to public duty without fault is enough for me."
units.literal: Zike once told those close to him, "Matters of letters and history—my younger brothers have them fully covered; I need not lead the way again. Only to withdraw after eating and attend to public duty without fault is enough for me."

units.zh: 子恪少亦涉學，頗屬文，隨棄其本，故不傳文集。
units.en: Zike in his youth also studied and wrote essays, but abandoned his drafts, so his collected works were not transmitted.
units.literal: Zike in his youth also studied and wrote essays, but abandoned his drafts, so his collected works were not transmitted.

units.zh: 子瑳，亦知名太清中，官至吏部郎，避亂東陽，後爲盜所害。
units.en: Zichan was also famous in the Taiqing era. He reached the post of Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel, fled the turmoil to Dongyang, and was later killed by bandits.
units.literal: Zichan was also famous in the Taiqing era; he reached the post of Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel, fled the turmoil to Dongyang, and was later killed by bandits.

units.zh: 子範字景則，子恪第六弟也。
units.en: Zifan, style name Jingze, was Zike's sixth younger brother.
units.literal: Zifan, style name Jingze, was Zike's sixth younger brother.

units.zh: 齊永明十年，封祁陽縣侯，拜太子洗馬。
units.en: In the tenth year of Yongming of Qi he was enfeoffed Marquis of Qiyang and appointed Groom of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Yongming of Qi he was enfeoffed Marquis of Qiyang and appointed Groom of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 天監初，降爵爲子，除後軍記室參軍，復爲太子洗馬，俄遷司徒主簿，丁所生母憂去職。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount. He was made Recorder in the Rear Army, again Groom of the Heir Apparent, soon transferred to Chief Clerk of the Minister of State, and resigned on mourning for his birth mother.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount; he was made Recorder in the Rear Army, again Groom of the Heir Apparent, soon transferred to Chief Clerk of the Minister of State, and resigned on mourning for his birth mother.

units.zh: 子範有孝性，居喪以毀聞。
units.en: Zifan was filial; during mourning his devastation was renowned.
units.literal: Zifan was filial; during mourning his devastation was renowned.

units.zh: 服闋，又爲司徒主簿，累遷丹陽尹丞，太子中舍人。
units.en: When mourning ended he again served as Chief Clerk of the Minister of State and was promoted through posts to Assistant Magistrate of Danyang and Attendant to the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: When mourning ended he again served as Chief Clerk of the Minister of State and was promoted through posts to Assistant Magistrate of Danyang and Attendant to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 出爲建安太守，還除大司馬南平王戶曹屬，從事中郎。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Jian'an. On his return he was made Registrar in the household of the Minister of War for the Prince of Nanping, and Follower.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Jian'an; on return he was made Registrar in the Household of the Minister of War for the Prince of Nanping, and Follower.

units.zh: 王愛文學士，子範偏被恩遇，嘗曰：「此宗室奇才也。」
units.en: The prince loved literary scholars. Zifan was especially favored, and the prince often said, "This is an extraordinary talent of the imperial house."
units.literal: The prince loved literary scholars; Zifan was especially favored, and the prince often said, "This is an extraordinary talent of the imperial house."

units.zh: 使制《千字文》，其辭甚美，王命記室蔡薳注釋之。
units.en: He had him compose the Thousand-Character Classic. The text was very fine, and the prince ordered his Recorder Cai Yun to annotate it.
units.literal: He had him compose the Thousand-Character Classic; the text was very fine, and the prince ordered his Recorder Cai Yun to annotate it.

units.zh: 自是府中文筆，皆使草之。
units.en: From then on all documents of the princely establishment were drafted by him.
units.literal: From then on all documents of the establishment were drafted by him.

units.zh: 王薨，子範遷宣惠諮議參軍，護軍臨賀王正德長史。
units.en: When the prince died, Zifan was transferred to Consultant of the Xuanhui General, and Chief Clerk to Zhengde, Prince of Linhe and Protector of the Army.
units.literal: When the prince died, Zifan was transferred to Consultant and Follower on the staff of the Xuanhui Prince, and Chief Clerk to the Prince of Linhe Zhengde.

units.zh: 正德爲丹陽尹，復爲正德信威長史，領尹丞。
units.en: When Zhengde was Governor of Danyang, Zifan again served as his Chief Clerk with Acting Credence and as Assistant Magistrate.
units.literal: When Zhengde was Governor of Danyang, Zifan again served as Chief Clerk with Acting Credence and as Assistant Magistrate.

units.zh: 歷官十餘年，不出籓府，常以自慨，而諸弟並登顯列，意不能平，及是爲到府箋曰：「上籓首佐，於茲再忝，河南雌伏，自此重昇。
units.en: Having held office for more than ten years without leaving the princely establishment, he often sighed at this himself, while his younger brothers all reached prominent rank. He could not compose his mind, and on taking up this post he submitted a memorial saying, "Chief aide of a first-rank princely fief—here again I bear this post; the hen of Henan crouches in hiding—from here I rise once more.
units.literal: Having held office more than ten years without leaving the princely establishment, he often sighed at this himself, while his younger brothers all reached prominent rank; he could not compose his mind, and on taking up this post he submitted a memorial saying, "Chief aide of a first-rank princely fief—here again I bear this post; the hen of Henan crouches in hiding—from here I rise once more.

units.zh: 以老少異時，盛衰殊日，雖佩恩寵，還羞年鬢。」
units.en: Because youth and age differ in their season, and flourishing and decline fall on different days, though I wear favor and grace I still blush at my years."
units.literal: Because the old and young are of different times, and prosperity and decline fall on different days, though I wear favor and grace I still blush at my years."

units.zh: 子範少與弟子顯、子雲才名略相比，而風采容止不逮，故宦途有優劣。
units.en: From youth Zifan's talent and reputation were roughly comparable to those of his younger brothers Zixian and Ziyun, but his bearing and deportment fell short, so their official careers had their differences.
units.literal: Zifan from youth had talent and name roughly comparable to his younger brothers Zixian and Ziyun, but his bearing and deportment fell short, so their official careers had their differences.

units.zh: 每讀《漢書》，杜緩兄弟「五人至大官，唯中弟欽官不至而最知名」，常吟諷之，以況己也。
units.en: Whenever he read the Han History, he would chant the passage on the Du Huan brothers—"five men reached high office, only the middle brother Qin did not reach office yet was most renowned"—and apply it to himself.
units.literal: Whenever he read the Han History, he would chant the passage on the Du Huan brothers—"five men reached high office, only the middle brother Qin did not reach office yet was most renowned"—and apply it to himself.

units.zh: 尋復爲宣惠武陵王司馬，不就，仍除中散大夫，遷光祿、廷尉卿。
units.en: Soon he was again made Sima to the Xuanhui Prince of Wuling but did not take up the post. He was appointed Grand Master of Palace Leisure and promoted to Director of Palace Affairs and Minister of Justice.
units.literal: Soon he was again made Sima to the Xuanhui Prince of Wuling but did not take up the post; he was appointed Palace Gentleman and promoted to Director of Palace Affairs and Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 出爲戎昭將軍、始興內史。
units.en: He went out as General of Martial Brilliance and Internal Governor of Shixing.
units.literal: He went out as General of Martial Brilliance and Internal Governor of Shixing.

units.zh: 還除太中大夫，遷秘書監。
units.en: On his return he was made Grand Master of Palace and promoted to Superintendent of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On return he was made Grand Master of Palace and promoted to Superintendent of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 太宗卽位，召爲光祿大夫，加金章紫綬，以逼賊不拜。
units.en: When Emperor Jianwen acceded, he was summoned as Director of Palace Affairs with the gold seal and purple ribbon, but because of the rebels' pressure he did not accept.
units.literal: When the Taizong acceded, he was summoned as Director of Palace Affairs with the gold seal and purple ribbon, but because of the rebels' pressure he did not accept.

units.zh: 其年葬簡皇后，使與張纘俱制哀策文，太宗覽讀之，曰：「今葬禮雖闕，此文猶不減於舊。」
units.en: That year at the burial of Empress Jian he and Zhang Zuan were commissioned to compose the mourning eulogy. Emperor Jianwen read it and said, "Though the burial rites fall short today, this text is still not inferior to those of old."
units.literal: That year at the burial of Empress Jian he and Zhang Xu were commissioned to compose the mourning eulogy; the Taizong read it and said, "Though the burial rites fall short today, this text is still not inferior to those of old."

units.zh: 尋遇疾卒，時年六十四。
units.en: Soon he fell ill and died, aged sixty-four.
units.literal: Soon he fell ill and died, aged sixty-four.

units.zh: 賊平後，世祖追贈金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: After the rebels were pacified, Emperor Yuan posthumously honored him as Grand Master of the Palace with Gold and Purple.
units.literal: After the rebels were pacified, Emperor Shizu posthumously enfeoffed him as Director with the purple ribbon of the first rank.

units.zh: 諡曰文。
units.en: His posthumous title was Wen (Literary).
units.literal: Posthumous title Wen (Literary).

units.zh: 前後文集三十卷。
units.en: His collected works in all numbered thirty juan.
units.literal: His collected works in all numbered thirty juan.

units.zh: 二子滂、確，並少有文章。
units.en: His two sons Pang and Que both in youth had literary gifts.
units.literal: His two sons Pang and Que both in youth had literary gifts.

units.zh: 太宗東宮時，嘗與邵陵王數諸蕭文士，滂、確亦預焉。
units.en: When Emperor Jianwen was Eastern Palace Heir, he often gathered with the Prince of Shaoling and several Xiao literary men; Pang and Que also took part.
units.literal: When the Taizong was Eastern Palace Heir, he often gathered with the Prince of Shaoling and several Xiao literary men; Pang and Que also took part.

units.zh: 滂官至尚書殿中郎，中軍宣城王記室，先子範卒。
units.en: Pang reached the post of Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat's Internal Section and Recorder to the Prince of Xuancheng; he died before his father Zifan.
units.literal: Pang reached the post of Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat's Internal Section, and Recorder to the Prince of Xuancheng; he died before his father Zifan.

units.zh: 確，太清中歷官宣城王友，司徒右長史。
units.en: Que in the Taiqing era held office as Friend to the Prince of Xuancheng and Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of State.
units.literal: Que in the Taiqing era held office as Friend to the Prince of Xuancheng and Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of State.

units.zh: 賊平後，赴江陵，因沒關西。
units.en: After the rebels were pacified he went to Jiangling and was then captured in Guanxi.
units.literal: After the rebels were pacified he went to Jiangling and was then captured in Guanxi.

units.zh: 子顯字景陽，子恪第八弟也。
units.en: Zixian, style name Jingyang, was Zike's eighth younger brother.
units.literal: Zixian, style name Jingyang, was Zike's eighth younger brother.

units.zh: 幼聰慧，文獻王異之，愛過諸子。
units.en: Intelligent from childhood, the Literary and Cultivated Prince marked him out and favored him above all his sons.
units.literal: Intelligent from childhood, the Literary Prince marked him out and favored him above all his sons.

units.zh: 七歲，封寧都縣侯。
units.en: At age seven he was enfeoffed Marquis of Ningdu.
units.literal: At age seven he was enfeoffed Marquis of Ningdu.

units.zh: 永元末，以王子例拜給事中。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan, by the rule for princes' sons he was appointed Attendant at the Imperial Gates.
units.literal: At the end of Yongyuan, by the rule for princes' sons he was appointed Attendant at the Imperial Gates.

units.zh: 天監初，降爵爲子。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount.

units.zh: 累遷安西外兵，仁威記室參軍，司徒主簿，太尉錄事。
units.en: He was promoted through posts to External Army Aide of the Pacifying West, Recorder of Renwei, Chief Clerk of the Minister of State, and Recorder of the Grand Marshal.
units.literal: He was promoted through posts to External Army Aide of the Pacifying West, Recorder of Renwei, Chief Clerk of the Minister of State, and Recorder of the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 子顯偉容貌，身長八尺。
units.en: Zixian had an imposing appearance and stood eight chi tall.
units.literal: Zixian had an imposing appearance, eight chi in height.

units.zh: 好學，工屬文。
units.en: He loved learning and was skilled at literary composition.
units.literal: He loved learning and was skilled at literary composition.

units.zh: 嘗著《鴻序賦》，尚書令沈約見而稱曰：「可謂得明道之高致，蓋《幽通》之流也。」
units.en: He once composed An Ode on the Wild Goose's Preface. Minister of State Shen Yue saw it and praised it, saying, "One may say he has attained the lofty reach of the Way—of the same stream as The Mysterious Communication."
units.literal: He once composed An Ode on the Wild Goose's Preface; Minister of State Shen Yue saw it and praised it, saying, "One may say he has attained the lofty reach of the Way—of the same stream as The Mysterious Communication."

units.zh: 又采衆家《後漢》，考正同異，爲一家之書。
units.en: He also drew on various Later Han histories, reconciled their agreements and differences, and produced a unified work of his own.
units.literal: He also gathered various families' Later Han histories, corrected agreements and differences, and made them into a single unified book.

units.zh: 又啟撰《齊史》，書成，表奏之，詔付秘閣。
units.en: He also memorialized to compile the History of Qi. When the book was complete he submitted it, and an edict ordered it deposited in the secret archive.
units.literal: He also memorialized to compile the History of Qi; when the book was complete he submitted it, and an edict ordered it deposited in the secret archive.

units.zh: 累遷太子中舍人，建康令，邵陵王友，丹陽尹丞，中書郎，守宗正卿。
units.en: He was promoted through posts to Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Magistrate of Jiankang, Friend to the Prince of Shaoling, Assistant Magistrate of Danyang, Palace Secretariat Gentleman, and Acting Director of the Imperial Clan.
units.literal: He was promoted through posts to Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Magistrate of Jiankang, Friend to the Prince of Shaoling, Assistant Magistrate of Danyang, Palace Secretariat Gentleman, and Acting Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 出爲臨川內史，還除黃門郎。
units.en: He went out as Internal Governor of Linchuan. On his return he was appointed Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
units.literal: He went out as Internal Governor of Linchuan; on return he was appointed Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.

units.zh: 中大通二年，遷長兼侍中。
units.en: In the second year of Zhongdatong he was promoted to Senior Palace Attendant with concurrent appointment.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhongdatong he was promoted to Senior Palace Attendant with concurrent appointment.

units.zh: 高祖雅愛子顯才，又嘉其容止吐納，每御筵侍坐，偏顧訪焉。
units.en: The Emperor greatly loved Zixian's talent and also admired his bearing and speech. Whenever he held a banquet Zixian sat in attendance and received special attention and inquiry.
units.literal: The High Ancestor greatly loved Zixian's talent and also admired his bearing and speech; whenever he held a banquet Zixian sat in attendance and received special attention and inquiry.

units.zh: 嘗從容謂子顯曰：「我造《通史》，此書若成，衆史可廢。」
units.en: He once said at ease to Zixian, "I am composing the Comprehensive History. If this book is completed, the various histories may be discarded."
units.literal: He once said at ease to Zixian, "I am composing the Comprehensive History; if this book is completed, the various histories may be discarded."

units.zh: 子顯對曰：「仲尼贊《易》道，黜《八索》，述職方，除《九丘》，聖制符同，復在茲日。」
units.en: Zixian replied, "Confucius praised the Way of the Changes, dismissed the Eight Canons, expounded the Regional Officers, and removed the Nine Mounds—sage standards match; again on this day."
units.literal: Zixian replied, "Confucius praised the Way of the Changes, dismissed the Eight Canons, expounded the Regional Officers, and removed the Nine Mounds—sage standards match; again on this day."

units.zh: 時以爲名對。
units.en: At the time this was considered a famous reply.
units.literal: At the time this was considered a famous reply.

units.zh: 三年，以本官領國子博士。
units.en: In the third year, in his existing office he concurrently served as Erudite of the Imperial University.
units.literal: In the third year, in his existing office he concurrently served as Erudite of the Imperial University.

units.zh: 高祖所制經義，未列學官，子顯在職，表置助教一人，生十人。
units.en: The classical exegeses composed by the Emperor had not been listed among the academic officers. Zixian while in office memorialized to appoint one teaching assistant and ten students.
units.literal: The classical exegeses composed by the High Ancestor had not been listed among the academic officers; Zixian while in office memorialized to appoint one teaching assistant and ten students.

units.zh: 又啟撰高祖集，并《普通北伐記》。
units.en: He also memorialized to compile the Emperor's collected writings, together with the Record of the Putong Northern Campaign.
units.literal: He also memorialized to compile the High Ancestor's collected writings, together with the Record of the Putong Northern Campaign.

units.zh: 其年遷國子祭酒，又加侍中，於學遞述高祖《五經義》。
units.en: That year he was promoted to Libationer of the Imperial University and also added as Palace Attendant. At the academy he lectured in succession on the Emperor's Exegeses of the Five Classics.
units.literal: That year he was promoted to Libationer of the Imperial University and also added as Palace Attendant; at the academy he lectured in succession on the High Ancestor's Exegeses of the Five Classics.

units.zh: 五年，遷吏部尚書，侍中如故。
units.en: In the fifth year he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, retaining his post as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, retaining his post as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 子顯性凝簡，頗負其才氣。
units.en: Zixian's nature was reserved and terse, and he rather relied on his talent and spirit.
units.literal: Zixian's nature was reserved and terse; he rather relied on his talent and spirit.

units.zh: 及掌選，見九流賓客，不與交言，但舉扇一撝而已，衣冠竊恨之。
units.en: When he took charge of selection, upon seeing guests of every sort he would not converse with them but only raise his fan in a wave. The gentry secretly resented this.
units.literal: When he took charge of selection, upon seeing guests of every sort he would not converse with them but only raise his fan in a wave; the gentry secretly resented this.

units.zh: 然太宗素重其爲人，在東宮時，每引與促宴。
units.en: Yet Emperor Jianwen had always valued his person. When in the Eastern Palace he often drew him into intimate banquets.
units.literal: Yet the Taizong had always valued his person; when in the Eastern Palace he often drew him into intimate banquets.

units.zh: 子顯嘗起更衣，太宗謂坐客曰：「嘗聞異人間出，今日始知是蕭尚書。」
units.en: Zixian once rose to change his clothes. Emperor Jianwen said to the seated guests, "I have heard that extraordinary men appear from time to time; today I know it is Director Xiao."
units.literal: Zixian once rose to change his clothes; the Taizong said to the seated guests, "I have heard that extraordinary men appear from time to time; today I know it is Director Xiao."

units.zh: 其見重如此。
units.en: Thus was he valued.
units.literal: Thus was he valued.

units.zh: 大同三年，出爲仁威將軍、吳興太守，至郡未幾，卒，時年四十九。
units.en: In the third year of Datong he went out as General of Benevolent Might and Administrator of Wuxing. Not long after reaching the commandery he died, aged forty-nine.
units.literal: In the third year of Datong he went out as General of Benevolent Might and Administrator of Wuxing; not long after reaching the commandery he died, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 詔曰：「仁威將軍、吳興太守子顯，神韻峻舉，宗中佳器。
units.en: An edict said, "General of Benevolent Might and Administrator of Wuxing Zixian—his spirit and bearing rise loftily; a fine vessel of the clan.
units.literal: An edict said, "General of Benevolent Might and Administrator of Wuxing Zixian—his spirit and bearing rise loftily; a fine vessel of the clan.

units.zh: 分竹未久，奄到喪殞，惻愴于懷。
units.en: Not long after receiving the staff of office, death came suddenly; my heart is pierced with sorrow.
units.literal: Not long after receiving the staff of office, suddenly death came; my heart is pierced with sorrow.

units.zh: 可贈侍中、中書令。
units.en: He may be posthumously appointed Palace Attendant and Secretary of the Palace.
units.literal: He may be posthumously appointed Palace Attendant and Secretary of the Palace.

units.zh: 今便舉哀。」
units.en: Let mourning be raised at once."
units.literal: Let mourning be raised at once."

units.zh: 及葬請諡，手詔「恃才傲物，宜諡曰驕」。
units.en: When burial was requested and a posthumous title sought, a handwritten edict read, "Relying on talent and disdaining others—his posthumous title should be Jiao (Arrogant)."
units.literal: When burial was requested and a posthumous title sought, a handwritten edict read, "Relying on talent and disdaining others—his posthumous title should be Jiao (Arrogant)."

units.zh: 子顯嘗爲《自序》，其略云：「余爲邵陵王友，忝還京師，遠思前比，卽楚之唐、宋，梁之嚴、鄒。
units.en: Zixian once composed a Self-Preface, which in summary says, "I served as Friend to the Prince of Shaoling and was honored to return to the capital. Thinking far back on former parallels, there were Tang and Song of Chu, Yan and Zou of Liang.
units.literal: Zixian once composed a Self-Preface, which in summary says, "I served as Friend to the Prince of Shaoling and was honored to return to the capital; thinking far back on former parallels, there were Tang and Song of Chu, Yan and Zou of Liang.

units.zh: 追尋平生，頗好辭藻，雖在名無成，求心已足。
units.en: Looking back on my whole life, I have greatly loved fine writing. Though in reputation I have achieved nothing, in what my heart sought I am already satisfied.
units.literal: Looking back on my whole life, I have greatly loved fine writing; though in reputation I have achieved nothing, in what my heart sought I am already satisfied.

units.zh: 若乃登高自極，臨水送歸，風動春朝，月明秋夜，早雁初鷪，開花落葉，有來斯應，每不能已也。
units.en: Whether climbing high to the utmost, facing water to send off the returning, wind stirring on a spring morning, moon bright on an autumn night, early geese and first orioles, blossoms opening and leaves falling—when these come, I respond and each time cannot restrain myself.
units.literal: As for climbing high to the utmost, facing water to send off the returning, wind stirring on a spring morning, moon bright on an autumn night, early geese and first orioles, blossoms opening and leaves falling—when these come, I respond and each time cannot restrain myself.

units.zh: 前世賈、傅、崔、馬、邯鄲、繆、路之徒，並以文章顯，所以屢上歌頌，自比古人。
units.en: Men of former ages such as Jia, Fu, Cui, Ma, Handan, Miao, and Lu all became famous through literature. Therefore I repeatedly submitted songs of praise and compared myself to the ancients.
units.literal: Men of former ages such as Jia, Fu, Cui, Ma, Handan, Miao, and Lu all became famous through literature; therefore I repeatedly submitted songs of praise and compared myself to the ancients.

units.zh: 天監十六年，始預九日朝宴，稠人廣坐，獨受旨云：『今雲物甚美，卿得不斐然賦詩。』
units.en: In the sixteenth year of Tianjian I first took part in the Double Ninth court banquet. In a dense crowd and broad seating I alone received the command, "Today the clouds and scenery are very fine—you must compose a splendid poem."
units.literal: In the sixteenth year of Tianjian I first took part in the Double Ninth court banquet; in a dense crowd and broad seating I alone received the command, "Today the clouds and scenery are very fine—you must compose a splendid poem."

units.zh: 詩旣成，又降帝旨曰：『可謂才子。』
units.en: When the poem was complete, the imperial command came down again, "One may call you a talented man."
units.literal: When the poem was complete, the imperial command came down again, "One may call you a talented man."

units.zh: 餘退謂人曰：『一顧之恩，非望而至。
units.en: I withdrew and said to others, "A single glance of favor—beyond what I could have hoped for.
units.literal: I withdrew and said to others, "A single glance of favor—beyond what I could have hoped for.

units.zh: 遂方賈誼何如哉？
units.en: How then compared with Jia Yi?
units.literal: How then compared with Jia Yi?

units.zh: 未易當也。』
units.en: Not easy to match."
units.literal: Not easy to match."

units.zh: 每有制作，特寡思功，須其自來，不以力構。
units.en: Whenever I compose, I especially lack deliberate effort. I must wait for it to come of itself and do not construct it by force.
units.literal: Whenever I compose, I especially lack deliberate effort; I must wait for it to come of itself and do not construct it by force.

units.zh: 少來所爲詩賦，則《鴻序》一作，體兼衆制，文備多方，頗爲好事所傳，故虛聲易遠。」
units.en: Of the poems and fu I composed in youth, the single work An Ode on the Wild Goose's Preface combines many forms in its structure and is complete in many aspects of style. It has been rather transmitted among enthusiasts, and so empty reputation spreads easily."
units.literal: Of the poems and fu I composed in youth, the single work An Ode on the Wild Goose's Preface combines many forms in its structure and is complete in many aspects of style; it has been rather transmitted among enthusiasts, and so empty reputation spreads easily."

units.zh: 子顯所著《後漢書》一百卷，《齊書》六十卷，《普通北伐記》五卷，《貴儉傳》三十卷，文集二十卷。
units.en: Zixian's works included the Book of Later Han in one hundred juan, the Book of Qi in sixty juan, the Record of the Putong Northern Campaign in five juan, the Biography of Esteeming Frugality in thirty juan, and collected writings in twenty juan.
units.literal: Zixian's works included the Book of Later Han in one hundred juan, the Book of Qi in sixty juan, the Record of the Putong Northern Campaign in five juan, the Biography of Esteeming Frugality in thirty juan, and collected writings in twenty juan.

units.zh: 二子序、愷，並少知名。
units.en: His two sons Xu and Kai both were known from youth.
units.literal: His two sons Xu and Kai both were known from youth.

units.zh: 序，太清中歷官太子家令，中庶子，並掌管記。
units.en: Xu in the Taiqing era held office as Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, Junior Mentor, and concurrently managed records.
units.literal: Xu in the Taiqing era held office as Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, Junior Mentor, and concurrently managed records.

units.zh: 及亂，於城內卒。
units.en: When the turmoil came, he died within the city.
units.literal: When the turmoil came, he died within the city.

units.zh: 愷，初爲國子生，對策高第，州又舉秀才。
units.en: Kai at first was a student of the Imperial University, ranked high in the policy examination, and the province also nominated him as Cultivated Talent.
units.literal: Kai at first was a student of the Imperial University, ranked high in the policy examination, and the province also nominated him as Cultivated Talent.

units.zh: 起家秘書郎，遷太子中舍人，王府主簿，太子洗馬，父憂去職。
units.en: He began his career as Secretariat Gentleman, was promoted to Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Chief Clerk of a princely establishment, and Groom of the Heir Apparent, and resigned on his father's mourning.
units.literal: He began his career as Secretariat Gentleman, was promoted to Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Chief Clerk of a princely establishment, and Groom of the Heir Apparent, and resigned on his father's mourning.

units.zh: 服闋，復除太子洗馬，遷中舍人，並掌管記。
units.en: When mourning ended he was again appointed Groom of the Heir Apparent, promoted to Attendant, and concurrently managed records.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was again appointed Groom of the Heir Apparent, promoted to Attendant, and concurrently managed records.

units.zh: 累遷宣城王文學，中書郎，太子家令，又掌管記。
units.en: He was promoted through posts to Literary Scholar to the Prince of Xuancheng, Palace Secretariat Gentleman, and Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, again managing records.
units.literal: He was promoted through posts to Literary Scholar to the Prince of Xuancheng, Palace Secretariat Gentleman, and Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, again managing records.

units.zh: 愷才學譽望，時論以方其父，太宗在東宮，早引接之。
units.en: Kai's talent, learning, and reputation led contemporary opinion to compare him with his father. Emperor Jianwen while in the Eastern Palace drew him in early.
units.literal: Kai's talent, learning, and reputation led contemporary opinion to compare him with his father; the Taizong while in the Eastern Palace drew him in early.

units.zh: 時中庶子謝嘏出守建安，於宣猷堂宴餞，並召時才賦詩，同用十五劇韻，愷詩先就，其辭又美。
units.en: At the time Junior Mentor Xie Xia was going out to guard Jian'an. At a farewell banquet in the Xuanyou Hall the talented men of the age were summoned to compose poems, all using the same fifteen rhyme categories. Kai's poem was finished first and its wording was also fine.
units.literal: At the time Junior Mentor Xie Xia was going out to guard Jian'an; at a farewell banquet in the Xuanyou Hall the talented men of the age were summoned to compose poems, all using the same fifteen rhyme categories; Kai's poem was finished first and its wording was also fine.

units.zh: 太宗與湘東王令曰：「王筠本自舊手，後進有蕭愷可稱，信爲才子。」
units.en: Emperor Jianwen wrote to the Prince of Xiangdong, "Wang Yun is an old hand by nature; among the rising generation Xiao Kai may be praised—truly a talented man."
units.literal: The Taizong wrote to the Prince of Xiangdong, "Wang Yun is an old hand by nature; among the rising generation Xiao Kai may be praised—truly a talented man."

units.zh: 先是時太學博士顧野王奉令撰《玉篇》，太宗嫌其書詳略未當，以愷博學，於文字尤善，使更與學士刪改。
units.en: Earlier, Erudite of the Imperial University Gu Yewang had been ordered to compile the Jade Chapters. Emperor Jianwen found the book's detail and brevity not quite right, and because Kai was broadly learned and especially skilled in written characters, had him revise it again with the academicians.
units.literal: Earlier, Erudite of the Imperial University Gu Yewang had been ordered to compile the Jade Chapters; the Taizong found the book's detail and brevity not quite right, and because Kai was broadly learned and especially skilled in written characters, had him revise it again with the academicians.

units.zh: 遷中庶子，未拜，徙爲吏部郎。
units.en: He was transferred to Junior Mentor, but before he was installed he was moved to Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to Junior Mentor; not yet installed, he was moved to Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 太清二年，遷御史中丞。
units.en: In the second year of Taiqing he was promoted to Imperial Censor.
units.literal: In the second year of Taiqing he was promoted to Imperial Censor.

units.zh: 頃之，侯景寇亂，愷於城內遷侍中，尋卒官，時年四十四。
units.en: Shortly afterward Hou Jing raided and brought turmoil. Kai within the city was promoted to Palace Attendant and soon died in office, aged forty-four.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Hou Jing raided and brought turmoil; Kai within the city was promoted to Palace Attendant and soon died in office, aged forty-four.

units.zh: 文集並亡逸。
units.en: His collected works were all lost.
units.literal: His collected works were all lost.

units.zh: 子雲字景喬，子恪第九弟也。
units.en: Ziyun, style name Jingqiao, was Zike's ninth younger brother.
units.literal: Ziyun, style name Jingqiao, was Zike's ninth younger brother.

units.zh: 年十二，齊建武四年，封新浦縣侯，自製拜章，便有文采。
units.en: At age twelve, in the fourth year of Jianwu of Qi, he was enfeoffed Marquis of Xinpu. He himself composed the memorial of acknowledgment, and it already had literary grace.
units.literal: At age twelve, in the fourth year of Jianwu of Qi, he was enfeoffed Marquis of Xinpu; he himself composed the memorial of acknowledgment and it already had literary grace.

units.zh: 天監初，降爵爲子。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian his rank was reduced to viscount.

units.zh: 旣長勤學，以晉代竟無全書，弱冠便留心撰著，至年二十六，書成，表奏之，詔付秘閣。
units.en: Once grown he studied diligently. Because the Jin era in the end had no complete book, at his coming of age he turned his mind to writing. By age twenty-six the book was complete; he submitted it, and an edict ordered it deposited in the secret archive.
units.literal: Once grown he studied diligently; because the Jin era in the end had no complete book, at his coming of age he turned his mind to writing, and by age twenty-six the book was complete; he submitted it, and an edict ordered it deposited in the secret archive.

units.zh: 子雲性沈靜，不樂仕進。
units.en: Ziyun was quiet and reserved by nature and took no pleasure in pursuing office.
units.literal: Ziyun was quiet and reserved by nature and took no pleasure in pursuing office.

units.zh: 年三十，方起家爲秘書郎。
units.en: Only at thirty did he begin office as Palace Library Gentleman.
units.literal: Only at thirty did he begin office as Palace Library Gentleman.

units.zh: 遷太子舍人，撰《東宮新記》，奏之，敕賜束帛。
units.en: He was transferred to crown prince attendant, compiled New Records of the Eastern Palace, and submitted it; by edict he was granted bundled silk.
units.literal: He was transferred to crown prince attendant, compiled New Records of the Eastern Palace, and submitted it; by edict he was granted bundled silk.

units.zh: 累遷北中郎外兵參軍，晉安王文學，司徒主簿，丹陽尹丞。
units.en: He rose successively to external military aide to the Northern Central Commandant, literary scholar to the Prince of Jin'an, chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, and assistant Intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: He rose successively to external military aide to the Northern Central Commandant, literary scholar to the Prince of Jin'an, chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, and assistant Intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 時湘東王爲京尹，深相賞好，如布衣之交。
units.en: At the time the Prince of Xiangdong was capital intendant and deeply appreciated and liked him, as if they were friends in commoner clothes.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Xiangdong was capital intendant and deeply appreciated and liked him, as if they were friends in commoner clothes.

units.zh: 遷北中郎廬陵王諮議參軍，兼尚書左丞。
units.en: He was transferred to advisory army aide to the Prince of Luling, Northern Central Commandant, and concurrently Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: He was transferred to advisory army aide to the Prince of Luling, Northern Central Commandant, and concurrently Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 大通元年，除黃門郎，俄遷輕車將軍，兼司徒左長史。
units.en: In Datong 1, he was appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman and soon transferred to General of Light Chariots, concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: In Datong 1, he was appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman and soon transferred to General of Light Chariots, concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 二年，入爲吏部。
units.en: In the second year, he entered court to serve in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: In the second year, he entered court to serve in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 三年，遷長兼侍中。
units.en: In the third year, he was transferred to long-term acting Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to long-term acting Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 中大通元年，轉太府卿。
units.en: In Zhongdatong 1, he was transferred to Chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury.
units.literal: In Zhongdatong 1, he was transferred to Chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury.

units.zh: 三年，出爲貞威將軍、臨川內史。
units.en: In the third year, he went out as General of Firm Awe and Interior Minister of Linchuan.
units.literal: In the third year, he went out as General of Firm Awe and Interior Minister of Linchuan.

units.zh: 在郡以和理稱，民吏悅之。
units.en: In the commandery he was praised for harmonious administration, and the people and officials were pleased with him.
units.literal: In the commandery he was praised for harmonious administration, and the people and officials were pleased with him.

units.zh: 還除散騎常侍，俄復爲侍中。
units.en: He returned to court as Regular Attendant and soon again became Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: He returned to court as Regular Attendant and soon again became Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 大同二年，遷員外散騎常侍、國子祭酒，領南徐州大中正。
units.en: In Datong 2, he was transferred to Supernumerary Regular Attendant and Libationer of the Imperial Academy, concurrently grand rectifier of South Xuzhou.
units.literal: In Datong 2, he was transferred to Supernumerary Regular Attendant and Libationer of the Imperial Academy, concurrently grand rectifier of South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 頃之，復爲侍中，祭酒、中正如故。
units.en: Before long, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary, while remaining Libationer and rectifier as before.
units.literal: Before long, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary, while remaining Libationer and rectifier as before.

units.zh: 梁初，郊廟未革牲牷，樂辭皆沈約撰，至是承用，子雲始建言宜改。
units.en: Early in the Liang, the suburban and ancestral temples had not yet reformed the sacrificial victims. The hymn texts were all composed by Shen Yue and were still in use. Ziyun first memorialized that they ought to be changed.
units.literal: Early in the Liang, the suburban and ancestral temples had not yet reformed the sacrificial victims; the hymn texts were all composed by Shen Yue and were still in use; Ziyun first memorialized that they ought to be changed.

units.zh: 啟曰：「伏惟聖敬率由，尊嚴郊廟，得西鄰之心，知周、孔之跡，載革牢俎，德通神明，黍稷蘋藻，竭誠嚴配，經國制度，方懸日月，垂訓百王，於是乎在。
units.en: His memorial said, "I bow to consider that in sacred reverence you follow the constant way, honoring the suburban and ancestral temples, attaining the heart of the western neighbor, knowing the traces of Zhou and Confucius, reforming the victims on the altar, virtue reaching the spirits, millet and offerings presented with full sincerity in solemn matching—statecraft and institutions hang like sun and moon; instruction for a hundred kings lies herein.
units.literal: His memorial said, "I bow to consider that in sacred reverence you follow the constant way, honoring the suburban and ancestral temples, attaining the heart of the western neighbor, knowing the traces of Zhou and Confucius, reforming the victims on the altar, virtue reaching the spirits, millet and offerings presented with full sincerity in solemn matching—statecraft and institutions hang like sun and moon; instruction for a hundred kings lies herein.

units.zh: 臣比兼職齋官，見伶人所歌，猶用未革牲前曲。
units.en: I recently held a concurrent post as fasting officer and saw what the musicians sang—they still used the melodies from before the victims were reformed.
units.literal: I recently held a concurrent post as fasting officer and saw what the musicians sang—they still used the melodies from before the victims were reformed.

units.zh: 圜丘視燎，尚言『式備牲牷』；
units.en: At the Round Mound when viewing the burning offering, they still say, "Thus prepare the sacrificial victims";
units.literal: At the Round Mound when viewing the burning offering, they still say, "Thus prepare the sacrificial victims";

units.zh: 北郊《諴雅》，亦奏『牲雲孔備』；
units.en: the Northern Suburb's Xianya hymn also performs "the victims are fully prepared";
units.literal: the Northern Suburb's Xianya hymn also performs "the victims are fully prepared";

units.zh: 清廟登歌，而稱『我牲以潔』；
units.en: the Clear Temple's ascending hymn calls "our victims are pure";
units.literal: the Clear Temple's ascending hymn calls "our victims are pure";

units.zh: 三朝食舉，猶詠『朱尾碧鱗』。
units.en: at the three mornings' food-raising they still chant "red tails and green scales."
units.literal: at the three mornings' food-raising they still chant "red tails and green scales."

units.zh: 聲被鼓鐘，未符盛制。
units.en: The sounds spread among drums and bells and do not match the flourishing institutions.
units.literal: The sounds spread among drums and bells and do not match the flourishing institutions.

units.zh: 臣職司儒訓，意以爲疑，未審應改定樂辭以不？」
units.en: I hold office in Confucian instruction and consider this doubtful. I do not know whether the hymn texts ought to be revised or not?"
units.literal: I hold office in Confucian instruction and consider this doubtful; I do not know whether the hymn texts ought to be revised or not?"

units.zh: 敕答曰：「此是主者守株，宜急改也。」
units.en: The edict replied, "This is the responsible officer clinging to the stump; it should be changed at once."
units.literal: The edict replied, "This is the responsible officer clinging to the stump; it should be changed at once."

units.zh: 仍使子雲撰定。
units.en: Ziyun was then ordered to draft and fix them.
units.literal: Ziyun was then ordered to draft and fix them.

units.zh: 敕曰：「郊廟歌辭，應須典誥大語，不得雜用子史文章淺言；
units.en: An edict said, "Suburban and temple hymn texts must use the great language of the canonical edicts. One must not mix in shallow words from the Masters and histories;
units.literal: An edict said, "Suburban and temple hymn texts must use the great language of the canonical edicts; one must not mix in shallow words from the Masters and histories;

units.zh: 而沈約所撰，亦多舛謬。」
units.en: and what Shen Yue composed also has many errors."
units.literal: and what Shen Yue composed also has many errors."

units.zh: 子雲答敕曰：「殷薦朝饗，樂以雅名，理應正采《五經》，聖人成教。
units.en: Ziyun replied to the edict, "Yin offerings and morning feasts—music takes its elegant names. By principle one ought rightly to draw on the Five Classics, the completed teaching of the sages.
units.literal: Ziyun replied to the edict, "Yin offerings and morning feasts—music takes its elegant names; by principle one ought rightly to draw on the Five Classics, the completed teaching of the sages.

units.zh: 而漢來此制，不全用經典；
units.en: Yet since Han this institution has not fully used the classics;
units.literal: Yet since Han this institution has not fully used the classics;

units.zh: 約之所撰，彌復淺雜。
units.en: what Yue composed is all the more shallow and miscellaneous.
units.literal: what Yue composed is all the more shallow and miscellaneous.

units.zh: 臣前所易約十曲，惟知牲牷旣革，宜改歌辭，而猶承例，不嫌流俗乖體。
units.en: The ten pieces I earlier revised of Yue's knew only that the victims had been reformed and the hymn texts ought to be changed, yet still followed precedent and did not mind that vulgar custom violated proper form.
units.literal: The ten pieces I earlier revised of Yue's knew only that the victims had been reformed and the hymn texts ought to be changed, yet still followed precedent and did not mind that vulgar custom violated proper form.

units.zh: 旣奉令旨，始得發蒙。
units.en: Having received the command, I have at last been enlightened.
units.literal: Having received the command, I have at last been enlightened.

units.zh: 臣夙本庸滯，昭然忽朗，謹依成旨，悉改約制。
units.en: I have long been dull and slow by nature, but suddenly all became clear. I respectfully follow the completed command and have wholly changed Yue's system.
units.literal: I have long been dull and slow by nature, but suddenly all became clear; I respectfully follow the completed command and have wholly changed Yue's system.

units.zh: 惟用《五經》爲本，其次《爾雅》、《周易》、《尚書》、《大戴禮》，卽是經誥之流，愚意亦取兼用。
units.en: I use only the Five Classics as foundation; next the Erya, Book of Changes, Documents, and Grand Dai Rites—that is, texts of canonical edicts—and in my humble opinion I also take these for combined use.
units.literal: I use only the Five Classics as foundation; next the Erya, Book of Changes, Documents, and Grand Dai Rites—that is, texts of canonical edicts—and in my humble opinion I also take these for combined use.

units.zh: 臣又尋唐、虞諸書，殷《頌》周《雅》，稱美是一，而復各述時事。
units.en: I further examine the books of Tang and Yu, the Yin Odes and Zhou Elegantiae—praise is one, yet each again relates the affairs of its time.
units.literal: I further examine the books of Tang and Yu, the Yin Odes and Zhou Elegantiae—praise is one, yet each again relates the affairs of its time.

units.zh: 大梁革服，偃武修文，制禮作樂，義高三正；
units.en: Great Liang has changed its garments, laid down arms and cultivated letters, established rites and made music—its righteousness surpasses the Three Corrections;
units.literal: Great Liang has changed its garments, laid down arms and cultivated letters, established rites and made music—its righteousness surpasses the Three Corrections;

units.zh: 而約撰歌辭，惟浸稱聖德之美，了不序皇朝製作事。
units.en: yet Yue's composed hymn texts only soak in praise of sacred virtue's beauty and entirely do not narrate the imperial house's creative achievements.
units.literal: yet Yue's composed hymn texts only soak in praise of sacred virtue's beauty and entirely do not narrate the imperial house's creative achievements.

units.zh: 《雅》、《頌》前例，於體爲違。
units.en: The former examples of the Elegantiae and Odes—in form this violates them.
units.literal: The former examples of the Elegantiae and Odes—in form this violates them.

units.zh: 伏以聖旨所定《樂論》，鐘律緯緒，文思深微，命世一出，方懸日月，不刊之典，禮樂之教，致治所成。
units.en: I bow to consider the Treatise on Music fixed by the sacred command—bells, pitch pipes, and their woven principles; literary thought deep and subtle; once in an age; hanging like sun and moon; an unalterable canon; the teaching of rites and music through which good governance is achieved.
units.literal: I bow to consider the Treatise on Music fixed by the sacred command—bells, pitch pipes, and their woven principles; literary thought deep and subtle; once in an age; hanging like sun and moon; an unalterable canon; the teaching of rites and music through which good governance is achieved.

units.zh: 謹一二采綴，各隨事顯義，以明製作之美。
units.en: I respectfully gather and arrange piece by piece, each following its affair to display its meaning, to make clear the beauty of the creative achievements.
units.literal: I respectfully gather and arrange piece by piece, each following its affair to display its meaning, to make clear the beauty of the creative achievements.

units.zh: 覃思累日，今始克就，謹以上呈。」
units.en: Deep thought for many days—today it is at last completed. I respectfully submit it above."
units.literal: Deep thought for many days—today it is at last completed; I respectfully submit it above."

units.zh: 敕並施用。
units.en: The edict ordered all to be put into use.
units.literal: The edict ordered all to be put into use.

units.zh: 子雲善草隸書，爲世楷法。
units.en: Ziyun was skilled in cursive and clerical script and became the standard for the age.
units.literal: Ziyun was skilled in cursive and clerical script and became the standard for the age.

units.zh: 自雲善效鐘元常、王逸少而微變字體。
units.en: He himself said he was skilled at imitating Zhong You and Wang Xizhi while slightly varying the character forms.
units.literal: He himself said he was skilled at imitating Zhong You and Wang Xizhi while slightly varying the character forms.

units.zh: 答敕云：「臣昔不能拔賞，隨世所貴，規摹子敬，多歷年所。
units.en: Replying to the edict he said, "I formerly could not break free in appreciation and followed what the age valued, modeling myself on Zi Jing for many years.
units.literal: Replying to the edict he said, "I formerly could not break free in appreciation and followed what the age valued, modeling myself on Zi Jing for many years.

units.zh: 年二十六，著《晉史》，至《二王列傳》，欲作論語草隸法，言不盡意，遂不能成，略指論飛白一勢而已。
units.en: At age twenty-six, composing the History of Jin, when I reached the Biographies of the Two Wangs I wished to compose a discourse on cursive and clerical methods, but words could not exhaust the meaning and so I could not complete it—I only sketched a discussion of the flying-white manner.
units.literal: At age twenty-six, composing the History of Jin, when I reached the Biographies of the Two Wangs I wished to compose a discourse on cursive and clerical methods, but words could not exhaust the meaning and so I could not complete it—I only sketched a discussion of the flying-white manner.

units.zh: 十許年來，始見敕旨《論書》一卷，商略筆勢，洞澈字體；
units.en: For some ten years I have only now seen the edict's Treatise on Calligraphy in one juan, weighing brush momentum and penetrating character forms;
units.literal: For some ten years I have only now seen the edict's Treatise on Calligraphy in one juan, weighing brush momentum and penetrating character forms;

units.zh: 又以逸少之不及元常，猶子敬之不及逸少。
units.en: and also that Xizhi does not match You, just as Zi Jing does not match Xizhi.
units.literal: and also that Xizhi does not match You, just as Zi Jing does not match Xizhi.

units.zh: 自此研思，方悟隸式，始變子敬，全範元常。
units.en: From this I studied and reflected and at last understood clerical forms. I began to change from Zi Jing and wholly took You as my model.
units.literal: From this I studied and reflected and at last understood clerical forms; I began to change from Zi Jing and wholly took You as my model.

units.zh: 逮爾以來，自覺功進。」
units.en: Since then I have felt my achievement advance."
units.literal: Since then I have felt my achievement advance."

units.zh: 其書迹雅爲高祖所重，嘗論子雲書曰：「筆力勁駿，心手相應，巧逾杜度，美過崔寔，當與元常並驅爭先。」
units.en: His calligraphic traces were elegantly valued by the Emperor, who once discussed Ziyun's writing, saying, "Brush strength vigorous and fleet, heart and hand in accord; skill surpassing Du Du, beauty exceeding Cui Shi—he ought to race neck and neck with You."
units.literal: His calligraphic traces were elegantly valued by the High Ancestor, who once discussed Ziyun's writing, saying, "Brush strength vigorous and fleet, heart and hand in accord; skill surpassing Du Du, beauty exceeding Cui Shi—he ought to race neck and neck with You."

units.zh: 其見賞如此。
units.en: Thus was he appreciated.
units.literal: Thus was he appreciated.

units.zh: 七年，出爲仁威將軍、東陽太守。
units.en: In the seventh year, Ziyun went out as General of Benevolent Awe and administrator of Dongyang.
units.literal: In the seventh year, Ziyun went out as General of Benevolent Awe and administrator of Dongyang.

units.zh: 中大同元年，還拜宗正卿。
units.en: In Zhongdatong 1, he returned to court and was appointed Minister of the Imperial Clan.
units.literal: In Zhongdatong 1, he returned to court and was appointed Minister of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 太清元年，復爲侍中、國子祭酒，領南徐州大中正。
units.en: In Taiqing 1, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary and Libationer of the Imperial Academy, concurrently grand rectifier of South Xuzhou.
units.literal: In Taiqing 1, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary and Libationer of the Imperial Academy, concurrently grand rectifier of South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 二年，侯景寇逼，子雲逃民間。
units.en: In the second year, as Hou Jing's rebels pressed close, Ziyun fled among the common people.
units.literal: In the second year, as Hou Jing's rebels pressed close, Ziyun fled among the common people.

units.zh: 三年三月，宮城失守，東奔晉陵，餒卒于顯靈寺僧房，年六十三。
units.en: In the third month of the third year, when the palace city fell, he fled east to Jinling commandery and died of starvation in a monk's room at Xianling Temple, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: In the third month of the third year, when the palace city fell, he fled east to Jinling commandery and died of starvation in a monk's room at Xianling Temple, aged sixty-three.

units.zh: 所著《晉書》一百一十卷，《東宮新記》二十卷。
units.en: He wrote the Book of Jin in 110 juan and New Records of the Eastern Palace in 20 juan.
units.literal: He wrote the Book of Jin in 110 juan and New Records of the Eastern Palace in 20 juan.

units.zh: 第二子特，字世達。
units.en: His second son Te, style name Shida.
units.literal: His second son Te, style name Shida.

units.zh: 早知名，亦善草隸。
units.en: Known early, he was also skilled in cursive and clerical script.
units.literal: Known early, he was also skilled in cursive and clerical script.

units.zh: 高祖嘗謂子雲曰：「子敬之書，不及逸少。
units.en: The Emperor once said to Ziyun, "Zi Jing's writing does not match Yishao.
units.literal: The High Ancestor once said to Ziyun, "Zi Jing's writing does not match Yishao.

units.zh: 近見特跡，遂逼於卿。」
units.en: Lately seeing Te's traces, they now press close upon yours."
units.literal: Lately seeing Te's traces, they now press close upon yours."

units.zh: 歷官著作佐郎，太子舍人，宣惠主簿，中軍記室。
units.en: He held office as Assistant in the Composition Office, Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Chief Clerk of the Xuanhui Prince, and Recorder of the Central Army.
units.literal: He held office as Assistant in the Composition Office, Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Chief Clerk of the Xuanhui Prince, and Recorder of the Central Army.

units.zh: 出爲海鹽令，坐事免。
units.en: He went out as Magistrate of Haiyan and was dismissed on account of an affair.
units.literal: He went out as Magistrate of Haiyan and was dismissed on account of an affair.

units.zh: 年二十五，先子雲卒。
units.en: At age twenty-five he died before his father Ziyun.
units.literal: At age twenty-five he died before his father Ziyun.

units.zh: 子暉字景光，子雲弟也。
units.en: Zihui, style name Jingguang, was Ziyun's younger brother.
units.literal: Zihui, style name Jingguang, was Ziyun's younger brother.

units.zh: 少涉書史，亦有文才。
units.en: In youth he studied histories and also had literary talent.
units.literal: In youth he studied histories and also had literary talent.

units.zh: 起家員外散騎侍郎，遷南中郎記室。
units.en: He began his career as Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and was promoted to Recorder of the Southern Central General.
units.literal: He began his career as Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and was promoted to Recorder of the Southern Central General.

units.zh: 出爲臨安令。
units.en: He went out as Magistrate of Lin'an.
units.literal: He went out as Magistrate of Lin'an.

units.zh: 性恬靜，寡嗜好，嘗預重雲殿聽制講《三慧經》，退爲《講賦》奏之，甚見稱賞。
units.en: His nature was tranquil and quiet, with few desires. He once took part in hearing the imperial lecture on the Sutra of Three Wisdoms in the Chongyun Hall. On retiring he composed a Lecture Fu and submitted it, and was greatly praised.
units.literal: His nature was tranquil and quiet with few desires. He once took part in hearing the imperial lecture on the Sutra of Three Wisdoms in the Chongyun Hall; on retiring he composed a Lecture Fu and submitted it, and was greatly praised.

units.zh: 遷安西武陵王諮議，帶新繁令，隨府轉儀同從事、驃騎長史，卒。
units.en: He was promoted to Consultant to the Pacifying West Prince of Wuling, concurrently Magistrate of Xinfan. Following the princely establishment he became Follower with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies and Chief Clerk of the Cavalry General, and died.
units.literal: He was promoted to Consultant to the Pacifying West Prince of Wuling, concurrently Magistrate of Xinfan; following the establishment he became Follower with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies and Chief Clerk of the Cavalry General, and died.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：昔魏藉兵威而革漢運，晉因宰輔乃移魏曆，異乎古之禪授，以德相傳，故抑前代宗枝，用絕民望。
units.en: Yao Cha, Minister of Personnel of Chen, said: In former times Wei relied on military might to change Han's fortune; Jin through its chief ministers shifted Wei's mandate. This differed from ancient abdications where virtue was transmitted, so they suppressed the former dynasty's collateral branches to cut off popular hope.
units.literal: Yao Cha, Minister of Personnel of Chen, said: In former times Wei relied on military might to change Han's fortune; Jin through its chief ministers shifted Wei's mandate—differing from ancient abdications where virtue was transmitted, they therefore suppressed the former dynasty's collateral branches to cut off popular hope.

units.zh: 然劉曄、曹志，猶顯於朝；
units.en: Yet Liu Ye and Cao Zhi still shone at court;
units.literal: Yet Liu Ye and Cao Zhi still shone at court;

units.zh: 及宋遂爲廢姓。
units.en: by the Song they had become an abolished surname.
units.literal: by Song they had become an abolished surname.

units.zh: 而齊代，宋之戚屬，一皆殲焉。
units.en: In the Qi era, Song's kin by marriage were all annihilated.
units.literal: In the Qi era, Song's kin by marriage were all annihilated.

units.zh: 其祚不長，抑亦由此。
units.en: Their fortunes did not last long—this too was a reason.
units.literal: Their fortunes did not last long—this too was a reason.

units.zh: 有梁革命，弗取前規，故子恪兄弟及羣從，並隨才任職，通貴滿朝，不失於舊，豈惟魏幽晉顯而已哉。
units.en: When Liang rose in revolution it did not take the former rule. Therefore Zike, his brothers, and the clan groups all received posts according to talent, filling the court with the eminent without loss compared with old times. Was it only Wei obscure and Jin manifest?
units.literal: When Liang rose in revolution it did not take the former rule; therefore Zike, his brothers, and the clan groups all received posts according to talent, filling the court with the eminent without loss compared with old times. Was it only Wei obscure and Jin manifest?

units.zh: 君子以是知高祖之弘量，度越前代矣。
units.en: The noble person thereby knows the Emperor's broad magnanimity, surpassing former ages.
units.literal: The noble person thereby knows the High Ancestor's broad magnanimity, surpassing former ages.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 王羲之
units.en: Wang Xizhi
units.literal: Wang Xizhi.

units.zh: 王羲之，字逸少，司徒導之從子也。
units.en: Wang Xizhi, whose courtesy name was Yishao, was a nephew of Wang Dao, the Minister of Education.
units.literal: Wang Xizhi, courtesy name Yishao, was a nephew of Minister of Education Wang Dao.

units.zh: 羲之幼訥於言，人未之奇。
units.en: As a boy Wang Xizhi was tongue-tied, and no one thought him extraordinary.
units.literal: In youth Xizhi was slow of speech, and people did not regard him as remarkable.

units.zh: 及長，辯贍，以骨鯁稱，尤善隸書，為古今之冠，論者稱其筆勢，以為飄若浮雲，矯若驚龍。
units.en: As an adult he grew fluent and forceful in debate and was admired for his uncompromising integrity. Above all he excelled at clerical script, standing unrivaled across the ages. Critics described the movement of his brush as drifting like wind-borne clouds and as swift and powerful as a dragon startled into flight.
units.literal: When grown, he was eloquent and ample in speech, famed for moral backbone, and especially skilled in clerical script, being the crown of ancient and modern; commentators praised his brush momentum, deeming it drifting like floating clouds, vigorous like startled dragons.

units.zh: 起家秘書郎，征西將軍庾亮請為參軍，累遷長史。
units.en: He first entered office as a Gentleman of the Palace Library. Yu Liang, the General Who Conquers the West, recruited him as an army adviser, and he rose step by step to chief clerk.
units.literal: He began his career as a Palace Secretary; General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang invited him to be an army adviser, and he was promoted repeatedly to chief clerk.

units.zh: 遷甯遠將軍、江州刺史。
units.en: He was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Distance and appointed Inspector of Jiang province.
units.literal: He was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Distance and Inspector of Jiang Province.

units.zh: 羲之既拜護軍，又苦求宣城郡，不許，乃以為右軍將軍、會稽內史。
units.en: Wang Xizhi did accept the post of General Who Guards the Army, then pleaded repeatedly for Xuancheng commandery. When that was denied, he was appointed General of the Right Army and internal administrator of Kuaiji.
units.literal: After Xizhi had accepted Guarding the Army, he also bitterly sought Xuancheng commandery; it was not permitted, and so he was made General of the Right Army and Administrator of Kuaiji.

units.zh: 深為從伯敦、導所器重。
